newsitem.title: USA: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. wheat weekly export sales highlights -- USDA.

text.p: USDA wheat export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales of 177,500 metric tons (MT) improved from the previous week's low level and were 29 percent below the 4-week average. Increases reported for Israel (75,400 MT), South Korea (63,200 MT), Mexico (32,900 MT), and Japan (32,800 MT) were partly offset by decreases for Trinidad (71,000 MT--switched to 1997/98) and Peru (17,800 MT).
Sales of 91,000 MT for the 1997/98 marketing year were mainly for Trinidad (71,000 MT).

Exports of 339,900 MT were up 38 percent from the week earlier and 13 percent from the 4-week average. The primary destinations were Japan (86,900 MT), South Korea (69,200 MT), the Philippines (43,600 MT), and Israel (35,700 MT).
